payload.title: papyrus CLI parity: subscriptions and connections
payload.description:
**Milestone:** M3, public email and new stories

**Goal.** `papyrus notifications` beside the other groups in `src/papyrus/operator/group_commands.py` and `src/papyrus/operator/commands/`, through the signed-in CLI with no AWS login. Mutations write unless `--dry-run`, per the CLI's rule. `subscriptions list|add|remove`, `settings show|set`, `history`, `test`; `connections list|remove` for Slack and Discord once live. No raw address in default output.

**Acceptance.**
`features_backend/operator-cli.feature` scenarios; `docs/operator-cli.md` updated.

**Depends on:** PPY-44721a
